capabilities: Expose Zotero search APIs to other Obsidian plugins
Open a search modal that returns the selected Zotero item
Return item metadata (key, title, authors, date) for use in templates
Connect via ZotServer addon or Zotero 7 Local API
Select between personal and group libraries
disambiguation: Not a direct citation or bibliography tool; it only provides APIs for other plugins (e.g. Zotero Link) to connect to Zotero.
extras: Also points readers to the separate Zotero Integration plugin for citation/bibliography workflows. Includes developer contribution instructions and Jest tests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for plugins to access a Zotero library, so developers need a shared connection layer to search Zotero items from inside Obsidian.
summary: API bridge that lets other Obsidian plugins connect to Zotero via ZotServer (Zotero 6) or the Zotero 7 Local API.
